query:
INSERT INTO results (
                        student_id,
                        assessment_id,
                        marks_obtained,
                        grade,
                        result_status
                    )
                    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'PRESENT')
                    ON CONFLICT (student_id, assessment_id)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        marks_obtained = EXCLUDED.marks_obtained,
                        grade = EXCLUDED.grade,
                        result_status = 'PRESENT',
                        updated_at = now()
